results.detail: Tests run skillz new on a real paragraph fixture and on YAML and JSON spec fixtures in a temporary directory and assert on the generated SKILL.md frontmatter: kebab-case name equal to the directory name and at most 64 characters, non-empty description at most 1024 characters, and that scripts/, references/ or assets/ appear only when the spec asks for them; pyproject.toml declares no runtime dependencies, only pytest and ruff as dev dependencies, and a skillz console script; the CI workflow runs ruff and pytest on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest
